pain_sites: Began in the knees and spread to hips, lower back, shoulders, elbows and neck.
exam_findings: Pain and tenderness with movement prevented walking. Fluid was visible behind the left tympanic membrane.
possible_oxygen_toxicity_during_hbot: Right thigh fasciculation after 30 minutes of treatment.
followup: Burning on respiration on days 2–9 after treatment. The authors describe it as typical of pulmonary oxygen toxicity.

other_symptoms: Left arm numbness and difficulty breathing.
exam_findings: Anxious. Reduced left arm pinprick sensation from wrist to shoulder compared with the right.
possible_oxygen_toxicity_during_hbot: Dizziness and malaise at 70 and 200 minutes after treatment started.
followup: The authors report no further problems. Follow-up duration is unspecified.

pain_sites: Retrosternal and left pectoral chest pain, headache and mid-to-upper back pain.
other_symptoms: Difficulty swallowing and speaking for 20 minutes, irritability, shortness of breath, and tingling in both calves.
exam_findings: Nystagmus and slight erythema of the left tympanic membrane.
followup: The authors report no further problems. Follow-up duration is unspecified.
